“时间灵活、中文沟通、收入不错”可以吸引注意，却不能说明这份工作适不适合你。先把: “Flexible hours, Chinese-speaking, good income” may catch your attention, but it doesn't tell you whether the job fits. Ask about the work, location, hours, and pay before deciding to talk further. Complete information doesn't prove a job is real, but repeated avoidance of basic questions is a reason to investigate further or stop contact.
先分清楚：招聘、项目合作，还是购买一套赚钱方案: First distinguish a job, a project partnership, and a money-making package you're being asked to buy
有的帖子寻找按班次工作的人员，有的寻找接单协作者，也有的只是邀请购买培训或设备。: Some posts seek shift workers, others seek independent collaborators, and some merely invite you to buy training or equipment. First ask who assigns the work, who pays, and what must be delivered. Labels such as "partner" or "independent contractor" alone do not determine the actual employment relationship, work authorization, or tax treatment.
约谈前，拿到这六项信息: Get these six details before an interview
实际招聘主体、工作地址或远程安排，以及可以独立核对的联系渠道。: The actual employer, work address or remote arrangement, and a contact channel you can verify independently.
日常任务、语言与技能要求，需要搬运、驾驶或独自上门等情形是否说明。: Check daily tasks, language and skill requirements, and whether lifting, driving, or solo visits to homes are involved.
班次、每周预计时间、开始日期，以及是否需要临时待命。: Confirm shifts, expected weekly hours, start date, and any on-call requirements.
报酬金额、计费单位、结算周期、付款主体；避免只有“上不封顶”。: Pay amount, unit of pay, payment schedule, and who pays you—not just “unlimited earning potential.”
工具、材料、交通与其他费用由谁承担，是否要求先支付任何款项。: Who pays for tools, materials, travel, and other costs, and whether any upfront payment is required.
面试或试做的内容、时长与报酬安排，开始前取得书面说明。: Get written details of interview or trial-work tasks, duration, and compensation before starting.
三种需要停下来的资金要求: Three money requests that should make you stop
先交钱才能拿到工作：招聘方以入职名额、保证金等名义收款。FTC 将付费获得工作的: Paying to get a job: A recruiter asks for money to reserve a position or as a deposit. The FTC identifies paying for a job as a major scam warning sign. Don't keep paying simply because someone shows a company logo.
做任务要先充值：一开始给小额回款，随后要求补钱、买加密货币或解锁提现。FTC 的: Depositing money to do tasks: Small payouts at first are followed by demands to add funds, buy cryptocurrency, or unlock withdrawals. The FTC's task-scam guidance warns that earnings displayed on a screen are not necessarily real, withdrawable income.
收到支票后替对方付款：让你采购设备、转回“多付的钱”或购买礼品卡。FTC 提醒，: Receiving a check and paying someone else: You're asked to buy equipment, return an “overpayment,” or purchase gift cards. The FTC warns that funds appearing in your account do not mean a check has actually cleared. Don't send your own money on that basis.
过去付过一小笔，也不能证明下一步安全: A small payment in the past doesn't prove the next step is safe
把注意力放在下一步要求：是否要你承担费用、交出账号、替陌生人转钱或转寄物品。前面: Focus on what you're asked to do next: pay fees, hand over an account, transfer money for a stranger, or reship items. Earlier chats, video calls, or small payouts don't replace checking the actual hiring entity and work arrangements.
核验公司时，换一个独立入口: Use an independent source to verify a company
不要只打开招聘消息附带的网站。自己查找招聘主体的正式网站或公开电话，询问是否存在: Don't rely only on the website linked in a recruitment message. Independently find the employer's official website or public phone number and ask whether the role exists and the contact is authorized. A free email address isn't automatically a scam, and a company-branded address isn't automatically legitimate. Check whether the entire process is consistent. Reconfirm if the interview location, contact, or written job duties change unexpectedly.
先问岗位，不先交完整身份资料: Ask about the role before handing over full identity documents
初步沟通可以先说经验、可工作时段和所在区域。不要在公开帖子放社会安全号码、证件照: In an initial conversation, describe your experience, availability, and general area. Don't put Social Security numbers, ID photos, bank details, or your home address in public posts. If an unfamiliar onboarding link requests these, first verify who's collecting them and why. Submit formal onboarding documents through appropriate channels only after confirming the process is legitimate.
如果已经付款或提交资料: If you've already paid or shared information
先停止继续汇款，保存招聘内容、聊天、付款记录和相关账号。尽快联系实际使用的银行或: Stop sending money. Save the job ad, conversations, payment records, and related accounts. Promptly report the situation to the bank or payment service you used and explain that fraud may be involved; recovery depends on its review of the circumstances. The FTC job scams page has reporting links. You can also report or block the relevant BAYLINK post to avoid further contact, but a platform report does not replace action by your payment provider.
若已提交社会安全号码（SSN）或账户登录资料，另按 FTC《受骗后的付款与个人信: If you shared a Social Security number (SSN) or account login details, follow the relevant sections of the FTC's guidance on payments and personal information after a scam. If your identity has been misused, that official page links to IdentityTheft.gov for recovery steps. Don't use “recover your losses” links sent by the suspicious recruiter.
带着清楚的问题，再看下一条机会: Take clear questions to the next opportunity
浏览兼职信息时逐项核对岗位和报酬。不要把平台展示、手机号验证或资料审核当成招聘保: Check the role and pay details when browsing part-time listings. Being listed on the platform, having a verified phone number, or passing a profile review does not guarantee a job is legitimate.
